title: Optimal Grading: A Unified Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.23407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a unified approach to optimal grading in an all-pay contest in which a designer assigns a fixed vector of heterogeneous prizes to maximize expected total effort. The approach covers two information regimes and identifies a common principle: iron locally misordered incentive returns and assign prizes assortatively across the resulting grades. Under rank-only grading, assignments depend only on ordinal ranks. Ironing cumulative rank coefficients---via the least concave majorant or the pool-adjacent-violators algorithm---determines which adjacent ranks are pooled and which prizes are randomized within each grade. Under performance-contingent grading, assignments may depend on numerical effort. The optimum irons virtual ability, forms endogenous type grades, and assigns prize blocks assortatively across grades. translated_title: 最优分级：一种统一方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23407v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们开发了一种在全员竞赛中实现最优分级的统一方法，其中设计者分配一个固定的异质奖品向量，以最大化预期总努力。该方法涵盖两种信息机制，并确定了一个共同原则：局部熨平错序的激励回报，并在由此产生的等级间按匹配性分配奖品。在仅排名分级下，分配仅取决于序数排名。通过最小凹包络或池相邻违规算法熨平累积排名系数，确定哪些相邻排名被合并，以及每个等级内哪些奖品被随机化。在绩效条件分级下，分配可能取决于数值努力。最优方案熨平虚拟能力，形成内生类型等级，并在等级间按匹配性分配奖品块。低于最低通过努力的失败等级和一组努力区间实现了直接最优方案，同时预设了激励兼容性。
tldr: 本文提出一种统一的最优分级方法，通过熨平激励回报和按匹配性分配奖品，适用于排名和绩效两种信息机制，最大化竞赛中的总努力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified approach to optimal grading, ironing incentive returns and assigning prizes assortatively across grades under both rank-only and performance-contingent information regimes to maximize total effort in contests.
